1|## Chapter 38 — The Winter Conclave
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents gathered to survive the storm. You gather to decide what kind of storm you want to weather."*  
     4|*Elder Amara Hale VI: "We're not just sharing resources. We're reaffirming what makes us Martian."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a communal pulse: Habitat Council Request - Emergency Winter Conclave Scheduled. Elder Amara Hale VI adjusted her spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how communities actually come together in hard times, as she looked at the notification flashing across her console in the Valles Marineris Community Affairs Chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," she said, her voice carrying the rasp of years spent in neighborhood mediation and the quiet focus of generational wisdom, "confirm the nature of this request."
     9|
